items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-12-09
items.q: I lived there with Doug, Plotty Jack and some of them.

ctx.x: Everybody accepted it. And, uh... Some of them was playing, some of the fellas didn't even know. You see? Cause you'd take, like... Piano player. Elder Poinnelly.

Not used to playing hymns. Uh... You got a Lawrence. Uh... Banjo. Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... for the congregation of the church. And then I met on my last mother that died and I changed my pastoral instance and I met some nuns. We call them sisters, y'all. We call them sisters. Two of them had a youth period of the church. I lived there with…
Where was that? I was just out of Cincinnati.
